headline: Mario Game (Java)
description: This project was created to be a very simple recreation of the popular Mario game. Within the project files, there are classes for all the characters. A "champ" is defined as either Mario or Luigi, that the user can pick to play as. The "goomba" is an enemy within the game, where one is randomly spawned at any position within the frame.
